biography.text: Birmingham-born Moore was a centre-back and Jamaica international. He joined Albion in September 2001 and helped win promotions in 2002 and 2004, before playing his part in the 2005 Great Escape.

sources.label: Albion: Darren Moore in profile, 18 May 2018

biography.text: He returned to the club as an academy coach after retiring as a player. His six-match interim spell in 2018 brought wins over Manchester United, Newcastle and Tottenham, but could not prevent relegation.

sources.label: Albion: Darren Moore in profile, 18 May 2018

biography.text: Appointed permanent head coach on 18 May 2018, he left after the Ipswich draw on 9 March 2019. The caretaker and permanent periods are recorded separately here.
